SCHOOL EVENTS
No Registration Fees for School students
QUIZ COMPETITION
Fr. Ignatius Kandamkalam Memorial Ever-rolling Inter-School Quiz Competition
Guidelines & Rules:
Students studying in +2 / Higher Secondary who are interested in participating in
the competition should complete the registration by entering the required personal
details through the Google Form link available on the college website
[mgcollegepunnapra.ac.in].
The competition will be conducted in two stages. The first stage will be a 30-minute
written quiz on October 27 (Tuesday). Selected teams will then participate in the
final round, which will be held on the college campus.
Students participating in the quiz should reach the college campus by 9:30 AM.
Each team must consist of two members. Any number of teams can participate from
a school.
There will be no negative marking for wrong answers in the first-round written quiz.
The quiz-related instructions and communications will be sent to the registered
participants through the email address or mobile number provided during
registration. The top 10 teams securing the highest marks in the first round will
qualify for the final round.
The questions will be based on various topics, including Kerala history, arts and
culture, current affairs, science, mathematics, social science, and literature.
Certificates will be awarded to all participating students.
The First Prize will be ₹10,000, along with the ever-rolling trophy.
The Second Prize will be ₹6,000
The Third Prize will be ₹3,000
All questions and answers will be in Malayalam.
Students must arrive at the venue wearing their school uniform. They must carry
either a certificate/letter signed by the School Authority/Principal or their School ID
Card, which is mandatory.
Faculty Coordinator: Ms. Chithra Chandran (Mob: 9539844399)

--- Page Break ---

DISCOZA (GROUP DANCE COMPETITION)
Guidelines & Rules:
Each team must consist of a minimum of 5 participants and a maximum of 10
participants.
The performance must be between 5 and 7 minutes, including the entry and exit of the
participants.
Participants must bring their performance music track in MP3 format.
Costumes must be decent, appropriate, and suitable for the competition.
Vulgar gestures, inappropriate movements, or offensive content are strictly prohibited
and may result in disqualification.
Teams must report to the venue at least 30 minutes before their scheduled performance
time.
Medleys are allowed for the performance.
Any violation of the competition rules may result in mark deduction or disqualification,
depending on the severity of the violation.
The judge’s decision will be final and binding. No further disputes or appeals will be
entertained.
Faculty Coordinator: Ms. Elizabeth Varghese (Mob: 9539844399)
Student Coordinator: Gopika S (Mob: 8921568689)

--- Page Break ---

HENNOVA (MEHENDI DESIGN)
Guidelines & Rules:
Participants should be prepared to create traditional, floral, or Arabic Mehendi designs.
Only one design will be assigned to participants by the organisers on the spot.
Participants must create the assigned design within the allotted time.
Only natural mehendi should be used.
The design must be neat, creative, and appropriate for a college event.
The design must be completed within 1 hour.
Mehendi will not be provided by the organisers. Participants must bring their own.
Ready-made stickers, stencils, or pre-drawn designs are not allowed.
Participants must create the design during the competition. Reference images are not
allowed.
Participants need to bring their own model.
Participants must report 15 minutes before the event.
Sharing information, outside assistance, cheating, or tampering with the competition
process will result in disqualification.
Any misconduct or failure to adhere to the rules and regulations will lead to the
disqualification of the participant.
Decisions of the judges and event heads will be final.
Faculty Coordinator: Ms. Soumya V R (Mob: 9400434033)
Student Coordinator: Anugraha Biju (Mob: 7874489232)

--- Page Break ---

CYBER RUSH (ONLINE GAMING- E FOOTBALL)
Guidelines & Rules:
All matches will be conducted in a 1 vs 1 format.
All matches will follow a Knockout Format.
No registration fee is required.
Participants must complete the registration process to participate in the tournament.
The use of any type of cards, including Player Cards and Manager Cards, is strictly
prohibited.
There is no limit on team strength.
The match settings and additional rules will be communicated to the participants after
successful registration.
All participants are expected to follow the rules and regulations throughout the
tournament.
The decisions of the organizing committee regarding the matches will be final.
Faculty Coordinator: Ms. Sreekutty S. Kumar (Mob: 8281860265)
Student Coordinator: Abhiram G. Raj (Mob: 9895386547)

--- Page Break ---

KEY VIBE (TYPING)
Guidelines & Rules:
Open to registered school-level participants only.
All participants will receive the same typing passage, which will be provided at the start
of the competition.
The competition will be conducted for a fixed time limit announced by the organisers.
Participants must type the passage exactly as displayed.
Copy-pasting, external assistance, mobile phones, AI tools, websites or unauthorised
software are strictly prohibited.
Only the computer/system provided by the organisers may be used.
Typing speed (WPM) and accuracy will be considered for evaluation.
Errors, missing/extra words and incorrect characters will affect the score.
Participants must stop typing immediately when the time ends.
Any technical issue must be reported immediately to the event coordinator. Participants
must not alter system settings.
Participants must maintain silence, discipline and fair play throughout the competition.
Violation of rules or use of unfair means may lead to disqualification.
In case of a tie, accuracy will be considered as the deciding factor.
The decision of the judges/event coordinators will be final.
Faculty Coordinator: Ms. Reshma R (Mob: 8113833009)
Student Coordinator: Nazria Nazar (Mob: 9446908627)

--- Page Break ---

FIESTA (SPOT CHOREO)
Guidelines & Rules:
The song or music will be provided on the spot by the organisers
The performance must be within the specified time limit announced by the organisers
Participants must perform individually and create choreography based on the given
music
Pre-prepared choreography, mobile phones, reference videos or outside assistance are not
permitted
Appropriate gestures and expressions must be maintained throughout the performance
Vulgar, obscene or inappropriate movements/gestures may lead to disqualification
Props may be used only if permitted by the organizers and within the given preparation
time
Judging will be based on creativity, choreography, musicality, expressions, stage presence
and overall performance
Participants must follow the instructions of the event coordinators and judges
The decision of the judges will be final.
Faculty Coordinator: Ms. Geeshma V Gregory (Mob: 8891822450)
Student Coordinator: Dennamol Shibu (Mob: 8606325098)

All matches will be conducted in a 1 vs 1 format.
All matches will follow a Knockout Format.

The use of any type of cards, including Player Cards and Manager Cards, is strictly

There is no limit on team strength.
The match settings and additional rules will be communicated to the participants after

All participants are expected to follow the rules and regulations throughout the

Faculty Coordinator: Ms. Josna Jose (Mob: 7593054254)

BEAST BATTLE (ARM WRESTLING)
Guidelines & Rules:
Eligibility: Open to registered college students only.
Categories: Matches may be conducted separately for Men and Women.
Match Format: Knockout format; each match will be a best-of-one round unless otherwise
announced.
Both players must be square to the arm-wrestling table before the start of a given match
At the start of a game, both players’ shoulders should not be less than a fist distance apart from
their hands.
Players must start after they hear “Ready and Go”
To constitute a pin, you can touch any part of the other player’s fingers, forearm or wrist
You cannot touch your body with any of your hands during a competition
If you commit a foul three times, you will be disqualified from the match
For whatever reason the grip falls apart, the grip is placed in its right alignment again
If any of the player’s positions is such that his arm can be hurt or broken, the referee can stop
the match right away and rule it as a foul
The arm-wrestling match should be started with one foot on the ground. Once you hear ‘go’
, you
can lift your feet from the ground
If any of the players takes out his elbow from the pocket but no position is gained, and the
elbow goes back in the pocket, the match referee may issue an instant verbal warning
For any unsportsmanlike conduct, the referee can give a disciplinary foul. If the competitor’s
elbow is out of the pocket when he makes the pin, it is considered a foul, and the arm-wrestling
match will restart
Both players must maintain full contact with the peg at the time of the pin
False starting the match will result in a foul
Before the ‘go’
, you can only wrap 1 finger in the hand-grip
All decisions made by the referee are final
Faculty Coordinator: Mr. Arjun R Nair (Mob: 8138037112)
Student Coordinator: Muhammad Shafi S (Mob: 6238801772)

SECRET HEIST (TREASURE HUNT)
Guidelines & Rules:
Each team must consist of 5 members, and participants must carry a valid college ID
card.
Only registered teams will be eligible to participate.
No restriction on the number of teams from each college. Students of any UG/PG
stream can participate.
Teams must report at the designated venue before the scheduled starting time.
Mobile phones are not permitted during the hunt unless specifically allowed by the
organisers for a particular purpose.
Participants must strictly follow the instructions given by the organising committee,
coordinators and volunteers.
Participants are expected to maintain discipline, fair play and proper conduct throughout
the event.
The decision of the organising committee shall be final and binding in all matters related
to the Treasure Hunt.
Faculty Coordinator: Ms. Anila K Anil (Mob: 9526554056)
Student Coordinator: Ameena Fathima (Mob: 8301040728)

--- Page Break ---

CASE CONSPIRACY (CRIME INVESTIGATION)
Guidelines & Rules:
Each team must consist of a minimum of 2 and a maximum of 3 members. A maximum
of 4 teams per college is permitted.
The game is open to students from all disciplines and is not restricted to Psychology
students.
Teams must carefully observe and analyse all clues, posters, videos, and other materials
provided during the investigation.
Participants must pay attention to the official Instagram page, as posters, videos, and
updates may contain important codes, hints, or clues related to the case
Team members may discuss the case only among themselves and must not share any
clues, information, or findings with other teams.
The investigation must be conducted independently. External assistance, unfair means, or
any form of cheating is strictly prohibited.
Teams must report at the designated time and follow all instructions given by the
organisers. Late arrival may result in disqualification.
Any violation of the rules, misconduct, or attempt to gain an unfair advantage may
result in immediate disqualification.
In the event of a tie, dispute, or unforeseen situation, the decision of the organisers will
be final and binding.
Faculty Coordinator: Ms. Reshmi Rajan S (Mob: 9497470658)
Student Coordinator: Meenakshi S A (Mob: 9778473896)

--- Page Break ---

RETRO RUMBLE (SONG RECREATION)
Guidelines & Rules:
Participants must recreate a song sequence exactly as portrayed in the original movie,
including the performance, expressions, movements, and overall presentation.
Each team shall consist of 4–10 members.
Only Malayalam, Hindi and Tamil film songs are permitted.
The maximum performance time is 7 minutes. Participants must strictly adhere to the time
limit.
The original song/video selected for recreation must be submitted in MP4 format along with
the registration/submission.
The video should have clear audio and good visual quality.
Participants may edit, cut, or shorten the original song/video to fit within the 7-minute time
limit. The edited version must retain the sequence intended for recreation.
Participants may use costumes, props, accessories, and other suitable supporting materials to
make the recreation as close as possible to the original movie sequence.
The performance should focus on accurately recreating the original song sequence.
Creativity in presentation is permitted as long as the essence of the original scene is
maintained.
Participants must maintain proper decorum in costume, acting, gestures, expressions, and
movements throughout the performance.
Participants are advised to select songs and scenes that are appropriate for a college/school
audience and stage performance.
Songs or sequences containing sexually explicit, vulgar, obscene, or otherwise inappropriate
content are strictly prohibited.
Any performance considered inappropriate or violating the decorum of the event will be
disqualified and will not be eligible for prizes.
The decision of the judges/event coordinators regarding the eligibility and evaluation of the
performance shall be final.
Background dancers or crowd scenes may be simplified, but the key actions and visual
elements should be retained.
Faculty Coordinator: Ms. Neethu Raj (Mob: 9446670496)
Student Coordinator: Ardra S Anil (Mob: 9061185456)

--- Page Break ---

MYSTERY CIPHER (PICTURE PUZZLE)
Guidelines & Rules:
Any number of students can participate from a college.
A team of 2 students is needed to register for this event.
Emojis representing a movie, song, celebrity, phrase, or character will be displayed on
screen.
Teams must identify the correct answer from the emojis.
Answers must be given within the allotted time.
20 seconds per question. Once the time is over, no answers will be accepted.
After each round, teams with the lowest scores are eliminated. The remaining teams
proceed to the next round
No phones or electronic devices.
No help from the audience.
No shouting answers
No internet searching
No changing an answer after it has been submitted.
Organizer’s decision will be final in case of any dispute.
Faculty Coordinator: Ms. Aleena Justin (Mob: 9207433179)
Student Coordinator: Aneena S (Mob: 7034660773)

--- Page Break ---

BID BASH (IPL AUCTION)
Guidelines & Rules:
Each team consists a minimum of 2 members and a maximum of 4 members
Multiple teams from the same or different institutions are permitted
Open to UG and PG students
Students should bring a valid ID card or Government - approved valid ID card
The team with highest cumulative player rating will be declared the winner
In case of a tie in cumulative player rating, the team with the highest remaining purse
will be the winner
Writing equipment will be provided by the college
Any form of plagiarism or misconduct will result in disqualification
The decision of the auctioneer will be final.
Faculty Coordinator: Ms. Georgi S Vallavanthara (Mob: 9562393568)
Student Coordinator: Karthik A Potty (Mob: 9605023824)

--- Page Break ---

POINTS TO BE NOTED:
Applicable to college events only
A minimum of 4 teams must participate in a group event for Second Prize to be awarded.
.
A minimum of 6 participants for single event & 6 teams for pair event must participate in
a single/pair event for the Second Prize to be awarded.
If only one team/participant participates in an event, only 50% of the announced prize
amount will be awarded.
